paper_id: Wu et al. - 2015 - Static power of mobile devices Self-updating radio maps for wireless indoor localization
title: Static Power of Mobile Devices: Self-updating Radio Maps for Wireless Indoor Localization
motivation: Radio maps for WiFi indoor localization degrade over time due to environmental dynamics, but repeating site surveys is labor-intensive; mobile devices are mostly static yet unused.
problem_framing: How to automatically and continuously update a static radio map using only mobile devices without additional hardware, exploiting devices' static behavior as reference points.
key_insight: Mobile devices kept static 80% of the time can serve as movable reference points; the underlying RSS dependency relationship between neighboring locations remains stable over time.
method_signature: Trajectory matching for device localization + Partial Least Squares regression for learning RSS relationships between reference points and other locations.
evaluation_criteria: RSS prediction error (average <5dB) and localization accuracy improvement (2× better than static map after 6 months).
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Prediction accuracy still has minor gap (0.34m) from ground truth; requires evenly distributed reference points for best performance.
evidence_for_taste: requires no additional hardware or extra user intervention
the underlying relationship of how RSS depends on its neighbors would be relatively stable over time
employs ordinary users' mobile devices as movable reference points
neither static nor mobile data alone are capable
the predicted radio map is of no reason to be better
thinking_moves: 把'移动设备'的静止状态当作未被开发的资源，而非噪声
利用惯性传感器轨迹的几何约束来约束RSS指纹的不确定性
用PLS回归处理共线性问题，而非普通多元线性回归
将局部RSS变化归结为邻居关系的稳定假设
